fields.__previous_part_content__:
# W4 — Recoverable selected-store migration

## Objective
Convert every selected record in the root store, workflow-tools store, and isolated pilot to W2 typed sources/Parts without silent loss, while preserving identity and immutable legacy history.

## Requirements and design
- Scope roots: `/home/linus/git/meta-workspace/.workflow-tools/mission/missions`; `/home/linus/git/meta-workspace/workflow-tools/.workflow-tools/mission/missions` (inventory at apply time, not assumed empty); and `file:///home/linus/.copilot/session-state/ae41c0ca-75fa-497e-b4ac-90e3fa04f6ec/files/mission-install-pilot-workspace`. Root records are 25287294-8211-42e9-b2de-29a4f22be289 r3, 2579a971-92a4-5332-a65c-0ed9b7f80bf9 r4, 6610348f-38c4-55a6-bb94-708849fe2f69 r1, f304b589-7738-500a-8184-c12c1dac7498 r4; pilot e6e9c515-4f2c-40eb-968d-c3e1aa345dc2 r22.
- Planned API operations are `plan_migration`, `apply_migration`, `read_migration`, `resume_migration`, `rollback_migration`. Plan is read-only: record original CAS/revision, deterministic conversion, typed-block/payload digest, paths, and complete-directory snapshot location. Unsupported syntax is diagnostic and ineligible before mutation; no LLM rewrite or prompt-for-Part fallback.
- Preserve record IDs and every old revision/history file byte-for-byte. For legacy accepted revision N, apply appends schema-v2 revision N+1; it never rewrites N. Preserve metadata, ownership refs, results, prompt and distinct Part content.
- Before each CAS write snapshot the complete record; journal `planned|applied|verified|rolled-back|failed`. Multi-store work is non-atomic: resume retries only unapplied/failed original-CAS records; rollback only applied records; changed revision stops diagnostically.

## Examples
A supported r4 record produces its v2 r5 source/Parts with matching normalized payload digest and rendered Markdown while r1–r4 remain identical. An unsupported Part produces a plan diagnostic and no write. A failure restores its snapshot; a changed revision blocks resume.

## Validation
Add and run once the new `typed_migration` target: `cargo test -p mission --test typed_migration`. It covers plan/apply/readback, append-only revisions, snapshots, journal/resume/rollback, all three roots, and digest/render comparisons. No Python fixture or denial check; full suites remain W5.

## Non-goals and handoff
No live migration during planning, LLM conversion, new Mission, transport redesign, or guidance publication. W5 consumes verified migration behavior. Execution checkpoint: `feat(mission): migrate typed part sources`.

fields.__previous_part_content__:
# Requirements — recoverable selected-store migration

Implement W4 after W3. Migrate every record selected at execution across the meta-workspace root store, workflow-tools store, and isolated pilot. The workflow-tools store includes the newly bootstrapped execution Mission. Complete the plan inventory from **all selected-store records at execution**; the planning snapshot is not a fixed-count exclusion.

Before apply, plan read-only and record every source revision/CAS token, deterministic conversion, payload digest, target paths, and snapshot. Apply uses those source revisions as CAS preconditions, snapshots each complete record directory, appends v2 N+1 while retaining IDs and all old revision/history files byte-for-byte, then readbacks identity/history/results/ownership/prompt/Part digest and rendered output. A stale source revision stops apply/recovery diagnostically. Journal plan/applied/verified/rolled-back/failed enables resume only with original CAS and rollback only applied records.

Native prompts must be complete after conversion; no dossier is a runtime instructions dependency. Do not use an LLM, silently discard/opaque-copy unsupported Parts, or create a new Mission during migration. Add and run once `cargo test -p mission --test typed_migration`, then actual plan/apply/readback comparison. No duplicate `dossier_migration` target. Checkpoint: `feat(mission): migrate typed part sources`.
